programme.desc: While the Berlin Wall became the symbol of the Cold War, another border was just as deadly: the Baltic Sea. For nearly 30 years, thousands of East Germans risked everything to flee the GDR across the water. Almost 6,000 people attempted the dangerous journey to West Germany or Denmark. At least 140 died trying - more than at the Berlin Wall.

When Sun Meets Moon
programme.desc: In 1992, a heavy rainstorm caused massive power outage in Hong Kong. At that night, two young astrology enthusiasts, Moon and Sun, met under the starry night by the seaside. When their affection to each other grew, Sun was admitted into a boarding school and would move to another country in a few months under his father's plan. Like the sun and moon, the couple could hardly see each other despite that they were living in the same city, but their love endured amidst the separation and opposition from Moon's mother. Overcoming the challenges from teachers, friends and family, time has come for Sun to depart...

programme.title: Citizen of a Kind
programme.desc: The scammer who scammed my money asked for help! Duk-hee, an energetic woman looking into various loans due to a laundry fire, receives a call from a bank clerk named Son offering a reasonable loan. Sending money to Son who demanded various fee for the loan, she later realizes that the entire process was a voice phishing scam, leaving her in shock. Having lost her entire fortune and forced to live on the streets with her children, Duk-hee receives another call from Son one day... This time, it's a plea for help! Determined to rescue the scammer and recover her lost money, Duk-hee equips herself with various skills and, along with her colleagues, who are equally determined, to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: I Love Hong Kong
programme.desc: Ng Shun returns with his wife Shun-Soh and three children to celebrate Ng Kin's 60th birthday. Unknown to Kin, his son has gotten into trouble and is plotting for him to take the rap. At the same time, Long, a swindler who conned money from the neighbours 30 years ago is now a property tycoon. He promises to pay each of the 30 neighbours HK$100 million as compensation as long as a representative of each household returns to the estate on Lunar New Year's Eve. A mad rush ensues as Shun and his family tries to gather the old neighbours to avoiding missing the bonanza.

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Lau Ching Wan: Integrity
programme.desc: The multi-year ICAC investigation into the Lida Conglomerate is on the brink of collapse after the CEO's disappearance and the whistleblower's fleeing to Australia. To salvage the case, a top ICAC agent teams with a fellow investigator (who happens to be his estranged wife) and risks their lives to bring the witness back to Hong Kong.

programme.title: Exclusive Premiere: Good Game
programme.desc: The middle-aged Boss Tai owns an Internet cafe that has long since lost popularity; Bond, an e-sports player who is not yet in his thirties, is facing a career dilemma of declining strength; Fey grew up in a single-parent family, and she has been unemployed for more than five years since she graduated from college; The former action star Ba Ye, because his wife Ah Lan suffered from brain degeneration, the two over 70 years old tried to use video games to exercise their brains. Seeing a solicitation for a Hong Kong e-sports competition led Boss Tai, who wanted to save the Internet cafe, to form a team. Boss Tai, Fey, and Ba Ye, three rookies plus a young master, Bond, who is eager to prove himself, officially established the Happy Hour e-sports team. Family and friendship turned into a battle in the e-sports arena, an impossible battle that stopped them from regretting their dreams.

programme.title: E11 - Florida USA - Hogs and Gator part 1
programme.desc: Mike hunts hogs and Gator in the Everglades of Florida

programme.title: E12 - Florida USA - Hogs and Gator part 2
programme.desc: Mike hunts hogs and Gator in the Everglades of Florida. Mike cooks Hog and Gator BBQ and Fogs legs in butter and Garlic. Mike meets the Python Cowboy to hunt invasive python.

programme.title: E6 - What's a Nilgai?
programme.desc: Leysath is joined by his son, Jake, for a unique experience chasing an invasive Asian antelope in south Texas. Nilgai are secretive and are usually spotted in the dark with infrared technology. Making it all happen is Corey Spriggs, aka The Hog Snyper, who is as passionate about hunting nilgai as he is about reducing the feral swine population of Texas. The meat is prepared a few different ways, including an incredible smoked whole hindquarter. The group also takes to the waters surrounding South Padre Island for some speckled trout.

programme.title: E6 - Common Carp
programme.desc: Common carp are one of the most widely introduced species of fish in the world. However, most people in the U.S. won't eat them, referring to them as a 'trash fish.' Bowfisherman and fishing guide Curt Cich will tell you otherwise, as these fish are fun to bowhunt, have plenty of fresh meat and are delicious smoked. These fish are so plentiful, Curt runs a year-round full-time guiding service targeting only carp.

programme.title: E18
programme.desc: 《山河之影》改編自路陽執導的同名系列電影《繡春刀》，講述兩位少年以赤子情懷協力衝破人生困境的江湖故事。 建文三年，雞鵝巷的小賊李霧濟南府金事王克恭攜萬貫家財平調進入南京城，便盜錦衣百戶李東方之名帖潛入王克恭府夢想著順利盜寶，在一夜之間坐擁菜華富貴。不料王克恭府中暗流湧動，李霧被迫捲入了一場圍繞魚瞑鎖展開的前朝火器之爭中，原本作為局外人的李霧成為了魚瞑鎖的持有者，陷入了漩渦中心。兒時，將李霧詔獄中解救的孩童宋真如今已成為錦衣衛陸錚，與李霧成了同僚，相見不相認；和李霧曾同處個囚室的女童舒棠變成了夜不收刺客，並跟李霧成了間諜夫妻，共同完成夜不收的任務。朝野紛爭的陰暗與殘酷讓三人之間的感情也在連環鎖樣的陰暗中經受著考驗。當改朝換代的那一刻到來的時候，所有的戰事和未解的迷局，都將落下帷幕。

programme.desc: is a news magazine show that features extraordinary, extreme, and outrageous stories about Pinoy subcultures, inspiring human-interest profiles, groundbreaking innovations, and trending social phenomena that go beyond the ordinary. programme.title: MotoGP World Championship 2026: MOTUL GRAND PRIX OF JAPAN -MotoGP Qualifying[Live]
Her Vengeance
programme.desc: Chieh-ying, the head of a Macau dancing group, has a peaceful and calm life. One day, five drunken men, who were the murderers of Chieh-ying's dad, came to watch the show and had a brawl with Chieh-ying. On her way home, Chieh-ying got caught. She was raped and tortured by them. After that, Chieh-ying felt herself sick and was contracted the venereal disease. Therefore, she decided to go to Hong Kong to seek vengeance. She met a journalist and stayed at his home. To earn a living, Chieh-ying worked as a barmaid at a bar of Chow, her sister's ex-boyfriend with the help from Susan. One evening, Chieh-ying saw one of those five men when she was on the way to work. Susan lured him away so Chieh-ying could kill him. Chieh-ying then started a trail of bloody revenge...
